The '''twelve bladed satellite''' orbited [[Shrokaan]]. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] executed a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] on the twelve-bladed satellite of Shrokaan by exposing him to the void of space, as he was too dangerous to capture alive.
